species.name: Gawplet

dex.text: Four enormous eyespots and a very small body. It is not looking at you, but the wings certainly are, and that is just as unsettling.
dex.fact: A peacock butterfly flashes its eyespots at a bird and hisses by rubbing its wings together, which is startling enough to save its life.

species.real: The caterpillars of the peacock butterfly are black and spiny and feed in groups on nettles.

species.name: Argusine

dex.text: More eyes than wing now, in all the colours of a very expensive bruise. In Greek myth Argus had a hundred eyes, and this one is keeping count.
dex.fact: Peacock butterflies spend the winter as adults, tucked away in sheds and hollow trees, and are some of the first butterflies seen in spring.

species.real: The eyespots on a peacock butterfly are on the upper wings only; with the wings shut, it looks like a dead leaf.
